[[Football Federation Australia]] hoped to build on the success of the previous two seasons and on the interest generated by [[Sydney FC]] and [[Adelaide United FC|Adelaide United]] playing in the [[AFC Champions League 2007|2007 AFC Champions League]], and the [[Australia men's national soccer team|Socceroos]] competing in the [[2007 AFC Asian Cup]]. Based on their [[A-League 2006-07]] season performances [[Adelaide United FC|Adelaide United]] and [[Melbourne Victory FC|Melbourne Victory]] competed in the [[AFC Champions League 2008|2008 AFC Champions League]], making it two consecutive seasons in the competition for [[Adelaide United FC|Adelaide United]]. Based on the 2007–08 season of the A-League, the [[Central Coast Mariners FC|Central Coast Mariners]] and [[Newcastle Jets FC|Newcastle Jets]] qualified for the [[AFC Champions League 2009|2009 AFC Champions League]], as the competition's Premiers and Champions respectively. Changes included: *The [[New Zealand Knights FC|New Zealand Knights]], who folded at the conclusion of the 2006–07 season, were replaced by [[Wellington Phoenix FC|Wellington Phoenix]].{{cite news|url=http://www.foxsports.com.au/story/0,8659,21407148-5000940,00.html|title=Kiwis alive as Townsville pulls pin|work=[[Fox Sports (Australia)|Fox Sports]]|date=19 March 2007|access-date=19 March 2007}} *An increase of the squad size, from 20 to 23 players, increasing the [[salary cap]] from [[Australian Dollar|A$]]1.6 million to A$1.8 million.{{cite news|url=http://www.theage.com.au/news/soccer/the-time-is-right-to-go-into-the-refs-book/2006/12/30/1166895525216.html|title=The time is right to go into the ref's book|publisher=[[The Age]]|date=31 December 2006|access-date=24 January 2007}}{{cite news|url=http://www.theage.com.au/news/Sport/ALeague-lifts-its-salary-cap-to-18m/2007/04/23/1177180562411.html|title=A-League lifts its salary cap to $1.8m|work=[[The Sydney Morning Herald]]|date=23 April 2007|access-date=23 April 2007}} {{TOC limit|limit=3}} == Clubs == {{A-League 2007–2009 map}} {{Further|A-League#Clubs}} {| class="wikitable" |- !
